svg.title: Forge UGC — Home
svg.desc: Editable vector recreation of a game dashboard. A blue Create UGC card, purple Shop UGC card, and gold Play and Earn card sit below a glowing navigation bar. Silver horned hair, a thorn crown, butterfly hair, and a game controller are drawn entirely with SVG paths and gradients.

text.tspan: Turn your ideas into Roblox UGC
Explore and try on UGC made
